what: The card row slides one slot left every 3 seconds in .8s with cubic-bezier(.123,.96,.44,1). Cards are tilted alternately by ±2°, and on every slide they all tilt the opposite way over .8s, so the row sways as it flows. Once all have slid, the first card goes to the back and it loops endlessly. The peel type: every 4 seconds the front card tilts 50px left and −4° around its bottom-right corner and vanishes in .6s, while the other cards are pulled up one slot, each .1s later, over .7s (all at once at widths of 840 or less)

options.look: when peel, the front card tilts and fades away (original closing section card row)
options.every: Advance interval (seconds), default 3 (peel 4) — 0 means no advance and only a rock-type ± tilt (smile-days Hero row: the original’s CMS list loads late and misses the auto-advance start signal, so it actually stands still)
options.start: Seconds after attaching until the first flip timer starts, default 0
options.stagger: peel Type delay between cards (s), default .1

note: Pushes by the first card width of the track — keep card widths (including margin) the same. Not applied under reduced motion

from.where: index.html .sd-hero__row (original #sub_slider-track initSubSlider — updateRotationPattern ±2° transform .8s ease, track .8s cubic-bezier(.123,.96,.44,1), 3s) · shared.js closing section .sd-concept__row (#footer_slider-track initFooterSlider — slideOut-footer .6s ease-out, the rest .7s staggered 100ms, 4s)
